entries.zh: §S《Plantoids Species Pack》§!DLC包含植物头像，这些感性植物正将自己的种子撒向星际，并在那里扎根。
entries.en: §SPlantoid Species Pack§! is a DLC containing portraits of sentient plants, putting down roots across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S《Plantoids Species Pack》§!，因为该帝国的与其中的植物主题吻合。
entries.en: We're recommending §SPlantoid Species Pack§! as this empire suits its botanical theme.

entries.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
entries.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

entries.zh:
如果你的根扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的花朵，以果实之给养和树影之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把花粉和种子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当风中传来叶语婆娑，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将树枝伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的水果，咀嚼我们的枝叶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的阳光下茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的花园。
entries.en:
If your roots run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your flowers, nourish themselves on your fruits, and bathe in the shadow of your leaves. Let them carry pollen and seeds to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the wind brings you the sound of rustling leaves, you'll know your children have found a new home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, branches reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruits. They graze our leaves. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our seeds spread. Let the galaxy be our garden.

entries.zh:
如果你的菌丝扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的孢子，以菌杆之给养和菌盖之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把孢子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当大地中传来菌网呢喃，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将菌柄伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的子实体，咀嚼我们的菌褶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的土壤中茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的蘑菇花园。
entries.en:
If your mycelia run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your spores, nourish themselves on your stalks, and bathe in the shadow of your mushroom caps. Let them carry spores to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the earths brings you the thrums of a new mycorrhizal network, you'll know your children have found a home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, toadstools reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruiting bodies. They graze our gills. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our spores spread. Let the galaxy be our mushroom garden.

entries.zh: 在我们恒星基地建造的一座真空花园，长满各种用于吸引太空生物群的基因增强植物。
entries.en: A vacuum garden for our Starbase, full of plants genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.

entries.zh: 效果：\n$t$吸引太空兽群到恒星基地觅食，并将§Y种荚§!带走散播
entries.en: Effects:\n$t$Lures Space Fauna to graze at the Starbase, collecting §YSeed Pods§! for dispersal

entries.zh: 星环基地上建造的结满生物工程改造的果实的真空花园，通过基因技术增强对太空生物的吸引力。
entries.en: A vacuum garden for our Orbital Ring, blooming with genetically enhanced plantlife designed to attract spaceborne fauna.

entries.zh: 结满生物工程改造的果实的真空花园，通过基因技术增强对太空生物的吸引力。
entries.en: Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.

entries.zh: 拥有§Y$origin_fruitful$§!起源的帝国可以使用一项§Y特殊项目§!
entries.en: Empires with the §Y$origin_fruitful$§! Origin can use a §YSpecial Project§!

entries.zh: 来自完全不同生态系统的奇怪种子蛰伏在这颗星球上。
entries.en: Strange seeds from an entirely different ecosystem lie dormant on this planet.

entries.zh: $has_origin_fruitful_special_project_key$来开启种荚并殖民这颗行星。
entries.en: $has_origin_fruitful_special_project_key$ to open the Seed Pods and colonize the planet.

entries.zh: 来自另一片土地的种子在这里找到了肥沃的土壤，正在取代当地的植被。
entries.en: Seeds from another land have found fertile soil here, supplanting the local vegetation.

entries.zh: $has_origin_fruitful_special_project_key$来在战争期间在这颗行星上召唤陆军。
entries.en: $has_origin_fruitful_special_project_key$ to summon armies to appear on this planet during a war.

entries.zh: 来自另一片土地的种子在这里找到了肥沃的土壤，取代了当地的植被。
entries.en: Seeds from another land found fertile soil here, supplanting the local vegetation.

entries.zh: 摧枯拉朽的外星入侵植物
来自另一片土地的种子在这里找到了肥沃的土壤，正在取代当地的植被。
entries.en: Seeds from another land found fertile soil here, supplanting the local vegetation.

entries.zh: 我们的种荚已被太空兽群带去了$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系的$PLANET|Y$上，他们将在那茁壮成长成新的树林。
entries.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to $PLANET|Y$, in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system, where they generated a new forest.

entries.zh: 我们的种荚已被太空兽群带去了$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系的$PLANET|Y$上。他们将保持休眠，等待我们的开启。
entries.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to $PLANET|Y$, in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system. They will lie dormant until we're ready to open them.

entries.zh: 我们与$PLANET|Y$上的种荚已失去联系。他们似乎是被摧毁了。
entries.en: We lost contact with our Seed Pods on $PLANET|Y$. It's likely they got destroyed.

entries.zh: 访问$SYSTEM|Y$的太空兽群吃掉了我们果园的果实，现在正载着种子漂星过海。
entries.en: Space Fauna visiting $SYSTEM|Y$ ate the fruits of our garden, and are now carrying our Seed Pods across the stars.

entries.zh: 太空兽群已将我们的休眠种荚带到了§H[this.GetName]§!。通过向这颗行星发射一道聚能光束，我们可以刺激其生长，将这颗了无生机的星球转变为郁郁葱葱的新殖民地。
entries.en: Space Fauna have brought our dormant Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam at the planet, we can stimulate their growth, turning an uninhabited rock into a verdant new colony.

entries.zh: 我们的种荚被太空兽群带到了§H[this.GetName]§!，他们在此处得到了§H[this.owner.GetName]§!的栽培和照料。通过向行星发射一道聚能光束，可以将这片森林转变为§H外星植物军§!。这颗行星上§H外星入侵植物§!的等级越高，就会生成越多的陆军。
entries.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§! where they were cultivated and cared for by the §H[this.owner.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam towards the planet, we can stimulate growth, turning the forest into §HXenofloran Armies§!. The higher the level of the §HInvasive Xenoflora§! on the planet, the more armies will be spawned.

entries.zh: 一道加密信号唤醒了这些沉睡已久的外星植物。一旦被连根拔起，它们便会前进，用自身的根须作为沉重而迟钝的武器。
entries.en: A coded signal awakened these long-dormant alien flora. Once uprooted, they march, wielding their own roots as ponderous, bludgeoning weapons.

entries.zh: 我们为星系的太空生物群建造了一座花园。我们让其中开满了鲜花，结满了果实和黏性的种荚，时刻准备着附着在这些令人惊叹的生物的皮肤上。但这些深居虚空的生灵们会出席我们的盛宴吗？当他们咬下第一口果实时，所有的担忧便已烟消云散。\n\n从记事起，我们就已经在自己的星球上为各种动物提供果实与荫蔽。作为回报，它们替我们携带种子。如今，这一古老的契约被翻印到了星系的尺度上：太空生物将携带着我们的§Y种荚§!一同旅行。只要运气尚佳，我们的种子将会落在一颗§H可殖民行星§!上，并找到为我们的人民建造一座新花园所需的一切。我们只需要引导一道能量束将他们激活，就可以让我们无需派遣殖民船便可以定居到新的行星上。
entries.en: For the galaxy's spaceborne fauna, we built a garden. We filled it with flowers, fruit and sticky seed pods, ready to latch to the skin of these magnificent creatures. But would these void-dwellers appreciate our banquet? As soon as they bit the first apple, our anxiety dissipated.\n\nSince time immemorial, we have offered fruit and shade to the animals on our planet. In return, they carried our seeds. Now, this ancient pact has been replicated at a galactic scale: spaceborne fauna will carry our §YSeed Pods§! with them as they travel. With a little luck, our seeds will fall on a §Hcolonizable planet§! where they will have everything they need to establish a new garden for our people. We need only direct an energy beam to activate them, allowing us to inhabit new planets without having to send a colony ship.

entries.zh: 当进入一个新的星系，太空生物就会有概率将§H种荚§!丢弃在一颗宜居行星上。请耐心等待。
entries.en: When entering a new system, Spaceborne Fauna will have a chance of leaving the §HSeed Pod§! on an habitable planet. Be patient.

entries.zh: 太空兽群虽然能帮我们散播§Y种荚§!，但还是不如最近加入舰队的新成员来得靠谱。\n\n我们的§Y星种花园§!会给麾下的生物分发种子，然后我们就能直接派它们前往§H适合殖民的星球§!，在那里开辟出新的花园。
entries.en: Though we can rely on wild space fauna to spread our §YSeed Pods§!, we can do so more reliably with those who have recently joined our fleets.\n\nOur §YStarseed Gardens§! will distribute seeds to creatures within our fold, whom we can then send directly to §Hcolonizable planets§! to establish a new garden.

entries.zh: 我们打开了在§H[from.GetName]§!的§Y种荚§!，新生的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始生根发芽。
entries.en: Our §YSeed Pod§! on §H[from.GetName]§! opened, and the newly born [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun to dig roots.

entries.zh: [this.GetName]上的土壤里散落着似乎不属于当地生态系统的种子。在最低限度的光照和水分下，种子迅速地生长，新生的森林迅速包裹了整个行星，促进了我们的殖民活动。
entries.en: The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.

entries.zh: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\n根据我们的基因分析，这些生长快速的基因工程种子是由§Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!研发的。
entries.en: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\nAccording to our genetic analysis, these fast-growing, bio-engineered seeds have been developed by the §Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $origin.7326.desc.base$。我们的科学家无法分析这些种子的来源，但可以肯定一点：它们一定是经过人工基因修饰的，可以在外星土壤上快速扎根。
entries.en: $origin.7326.desc.base$. Our scientists have been unable to determine the origin of the seeds, but one thing is certain: they are artificial in nature, bio-engineered to quickly take root in alien soil.
Unlocks the §Y$decision_uproot_weed$§! Decision on this planet.

entries.zh: 在穿过[this.solar_system.GetName]恒星系时，一群太空生物遗留留下了一个未识别物体，并落到了[this.GetName]的地表我们很快抵达了撞击点，却发现当地充斥着从未见过的植被。这个坠落物似乎是某种殖民船：一个载着包括关键材料和新苏醒殖民者等等建造殖民地的一切必须品的种荚。
entries.en: While passing through the [this.solar_system.GetName] system, a herd of spaceborne fauna let an unidentified object fall onto the surface of [this.GetName]. We quickly reached the impact crater, only to find it filled with unfamiliar greenery. The fallen object resembled a colony ship: a seed pod containing all the necessities to start a new colony, from essential materials to freshly awakened colonists.

entries.zh: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\n据基因分析，这些特别的种子是由§Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!研发的。
entries.en: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\nAccording to our genetic analysis, these unusual seeds have been developed by the §Y[seeds_owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\n得益于这些种荚中的通讯系统，我们可以很快与这些种子的发源地帝国建立联络。
entries.en: $origin.7326.desc.base$\n\nThanks to the communication system in the seed pods, we were able to quickly establish contact with the empire the seed germinated from.

entries.zh: 我们星球上的外星植物已经生长得更加强大了。
entries.en: The xenoflora already on our planet grow even stronger.

entries.zh: 我们的殖民船刚刚着陆于§H[from.GetName]§!，但我们休眠的人民早已深深扎根在土壤中了。§Y种荚§!中所附带的额外[root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和资源将有助于我们在这颗星球上的殖民地发展。\n\n祝愿他们根深叶茂。
entries.en: Our colony ship just landed §H[from.GetName]§!, but our people were already there, lying dormant in the soil. The additional [root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and resources contained in the §YSeed Pod§! will help our colonists develop the planet.\n\nMay their roots spread far and wide.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的遥远[owner.GetColonistPlural]在恒星附近部署了一座§Y$starbase_outpost$§!，从而获得了§Y[Root.GetStarName]§!恒星系的控制权。
entries.en: Our distant [owner.GetColonistPlural] on §Y[Root.GetName]§! deployed an §Y$starbase_outpost$§! around the star, gaining control of the §Y[Root.GetStarName]§! system.

entries.zh: 我们与太空生物的关系相当独特，但我们并不是唯一尊重它们生存权的人。星海共同体刚刚通过的一项议案将有助于保护这些奇妙生物。
entries.en: Our relationship with spaceborne creatures is fairly unique, but we are not alone in respecting their right to exist; a resolution that has just passed in the Galactic Community will help protect the lives of these wondrous creatures.

entries.zh: 太空生物一直是我们的朋友，但并非所有的星海共同体成员都像我们一样热爱这些太空生物。他们刚刚通过的决议将我们的朋友——以及我们自己——的生命置于危险之中。
entries.en: Spaceborne creatures have always be our friends, but not all members of the Galactic Community share our love for the void-dwellers. The resolution they just passed puts the livelihood of our friends - and ours - at a risk.

entries.zh: 我们的敌人认为我们会屈服于他们的力量，就像被风吹倒的芦苇一样。他们忘记了植物有刺。\n\n我们的士兵睡在他们的土地上。如果有需要，我们可以将我们的§H外星入侵植物§!转变为陆军，保护我们的一切，扼杀他们所谓的他们拥有的东西。我们只需将能量束引导到指定的行星即可开始我们的入侵行动。
entries.en: Our enemies think we will bend to their strength, like reeds blown down by the wind. They forget that plants have thorns.\n\nOur soldiers sleep in their ground. Should the need arise, we can turn our §HInvasive Xenoflora§! into armies, to protect what is ours and to strangle what they call their own. We need only to direct an energy beam to the desired planet in order to begin our invasion.

entries.zh: §H[from.GetName]§!上的§H外星入侵植物§!突然长出肢体变成了一支军队。这颗行星正在遭到攻击！
entries.en: The §HInvasive Xenoflora§! on §H[from.GetName]§! suddenly sprouted limbs, turning into an army. The planet is under attack!

entries.zh: $PLANET|Y$上的种子已成长为一支陆军。
entries.en: The seeds on $PLANET|Y$ have grown into an army.

entries.zh: 投票支持伤害太空兽群
投票支持保护太空兽群
太空兽群会将我们的§Y种荚§!带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
entries.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our §YSeed Pods§! to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

entries.zh: 战争时期，我们的§Y种荚§!可以绽放成为陆军，随时保卫我们的殖民地或者入侵遥远的目标。
entries.en: In times of war, our §YSeed Pods§! can blossom into armies, ready to defend our colonies or to invade distant targets.

entries.zh:
$bombardment_seed_bombing$用超授粉的种子球覆盖行星，引起爆发性增长。
—对§Y陆军§!§E不造成§!伤害
—对§Y行星§!造成§H重度§!伤害
—对§Y人口§!§E不造成§!伤害
—将会轰炸不设防的星球
—在星球上生成地块障碍
entries.en:
$bombardment_seed_bombing$ carpets the planet with hyper-fertilized seed balls, causing an exploding growth.
- §ENo§! damage to §YArmies§!
- §HHeavy§! damage to §YPlanets§!
- §ENo§! damage to §YPops§!
- Will bombard undefended planets
- Spawns blockers on the planet

entries.zh: 行星的这一区域被无限增殖的外星植物森林所感染。
entries.en: This region of the planet has been infested by a constantly growing forest of alien flora.

entries.zh: 行星的这一区域被无限增殖的外星菌落所感染。
entries.en: This region of the planet has been infested by a constantly growing forest of alien fungi.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[this.GetName]§!的殖民地正在被超授粉的种子球轰炸。森林在世界各地快速增生，地面撕裂、建筑倒毁，[this.GetPlanetHabitat]上现在到处都是迅速生长的外星植物。
entries.en: Our colony on §H[this.GetName]§! is being bombarded with hyper-fertilized balls of seeds. New forests are sprouting everywhere, cracking floors, ruining buildings and filling the [this.GetPlanetHabitat] with rapid-growing xenoflora.

entries.zh: 种子轰炸在$PLANET|Y$上制造了一个新障碍地块。
entries.en: Seed bombing created a new blocker on $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: 若得以安抚，它们可以成为我们种荚的理想携带者。
entries.en: If pacified, they could prove themselves ideal carriers for our Seed Pods.

entries.zh: 尽管它们是肉食性的，但我们的研究人员开发的肉质球果对它们的口味也很有吸引力。
entries.en: While they are mostly carnivorous, the meaty, bulbous fruits our researchers developed appeal to their tastes.

entries.zh: 我们的§H$sm_feeder$§!现在能吸引§H太空变形虫§!种群了。
entries.en: Our §H$sm_feeder$§! are now capable of attracting §HSpace Amoeba§! fleets.

entries.zh: 我们不确定这些生物是否进食，只要他们吃东西就可以当做我们种子的携带者。安抚他们可以让我们进行进一步的研究。
entries.en: We're unsure these creatures are capable of eating, but if so, they could prove useful carrier for our seeds. Pacifying them would allow us to conduct further studies.

entries.zh: 为这些生物培育美味的果实颇具挑战。我们还不确定它们是在吃我们创造的玻璃状的球果，还是只是因为被其光滑的表面所吸引而随身携带。无论如何这都能满足我们的需求了。
entries.en: Developing a palatable fruit for these creatures has been a challenge. We're not sure if they're eating the glass-like pomes we created or if they just like to carry them around, enamored by their glossy surfaces. That's enough for our needs.

entries.zh: 我们的§H$sm_feeder$§!现在能吸引§H晶态实体§!种群了。
entries.en: Our §H$sm_feeder$§! are now capable of attracting §HCrystalline Entity§! fleets.

entries.zh:
关于这种温顺的生物我们已经了解了很多。

这种太空生物可以访问某种较为低维度的亚空间，所以他们能轻易地在星系间穿行。他们以许多气态行星上层大气中的气体为食，但已经喜欢上了我们的果实。他们即便在受到惊扰的情况下几乎不会发起攻击。

这就是我们种子的完美载体：平静、无害甚至有点无聊。他们隐藏着什么秘密吗？
entries.en:
and we already learned much about these docile creatures.

Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, these spaceborne lifeforms roam from system to system with remarkable ease. They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, but have taken a liking to our fruits. They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked.

The perfect carrier for our seeds: calm, innocuous, almost boring. Do they hide any secret?

entries.zh: §Y缇扬奇§!是我们最先遇到的外星物种，$origin.7000.desc.common$
entries.en: The §YTiyanki§! are the first alien species we encountered, $origin.7000.desc.common$

entries.zh: §Y缇扬奇§!是我们最新遇到的外星物种，$origin.7000.desc.common$
entries.en: The §YTiyanki§! are a new alien species we encountered, $origin.7000.desc.common$

entries.zh: 把更多的时间花在他们的研究上。
entries.en: Dedicate further time to their study.

entries.zh: 我们还有更要紧的事情。
把一些空间站人员投入到对缇扬奇的研究中，可以让我们进一步了解这些宁静而神秘的太空生物的习性。
entries.en: Dedicating some space station personnel to the study of the Tiyankis could give us further insights into the life of these pacific, mysterious voidborne creatures.

entries.zh: 通过对这些太空朋友进食习性的研究，我们的科学家获得了研究突破。$tech_space_whale_weapon_1_desc$。这项科技毫无疑问是非常有用的。
entries.en: By studying the feeding habits of our voidborne friends, our scientists have made a scientific breakthrough. $tech_space_whale_weapon_1_desc$. This technology will doubtlessly prove useful.

entries.zh: 这个社会一直花费大量时间在改善和爱护环境上，追求为居民们建造一个真正的天堂。
entries.en: This society has long dedicated itself to environmental care and improvement, striving to create a true paradise for its inhabitants.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢思维十分爱护环境，通过建造的天堂追求协同上的完美。
entries.en: The Hive Mind cares for the environment, building a paradise in pursuit of synergistic perfection.

entries.zh: 荒野渴望一种真正完美的协同状态，因此授权植物和真菌共生体来改变周围的世界。
entries.en: This Wilderness desires a truly synergistic state of perfection, and so empowers its floral and fungal symbionts to transform the world around them.

entries.zh: 可以在你和你附庸初始物种的理想星球上建造£building£§Y$building_gaiaseeders$§!。\n$building_gaiaseeders_all_desc$\n当解锁更高级的£society£§Y环境改造§!科技后，£building£§Y$building_gaiaseeders$§!也可以在其他类型的行星上建造。
entries.en: Can build £building£ §Y$building_gaiaseeders$§! on your and your vassal's worlds ideal to your starting species.\n$building_gaiaseeders_all_desc$\nAs you unlock improved £society£ §YTerraforming§! technologies, £building£ §Y$building_gaiaseeders$§! can be constructed on additional planet types.

entries.zh: §R选择这个飞升天赋将使得$civic_idyllic_bloom$理念失效§!
entries.en: §RChoosing this Ascension Perk will deactivate the $civic_idyllic_bloom$ Civic.§!

entries.zh: 盖亚播种器将[This.GetName]成功地转化为$pc_gaia$之后，它会用于让我们的人口进一步适应这颗星球。\n\n§Y$trait_plantoid_bloomed$§!和§Y$trait_plantoid_budding$§!特质的效果提高§G+50%§!。
entries.en: Having completed transformation of [This.GetName] into a $pc_gaia$, the Gaia Seeder will now transform our population to better adapt them to this world.\n\nIncreases the effects of the §Y$trait_plantoid_bloomed$§! and §Y$trait_plantoid_budding$§! Traits by §G+50%§!.
\nThe next Bloom on §Y[This.GetName]§! will occur on §Y[This.gaia_seeder_bloom_timer]§!.

entries.zh: $PLANET|Y$上的盖亚播种器又一次引发了绽放，增加了我们的£pop£人口。
entries.en: Our Gaia Seeder on $PLANET|Y$ has released another Bloom, improving our £pop£ Pops.

entries.zh: 遍布行星的设施会通过4个升级阶段逐步将星球转变为§Y盖亚星球§!。
entries.en: Facilities spread across the planet progressively bring it closer to becoming a §YGaia World§!, through 4 upgrade phases.
$building_gaiaseeders_all_desc$\n\nThis is the initial growth boost phase.

entries.zh: $building_gaiaseeders_all_desc$\n\n这个阶段致力于提升宜居性。
结束后将星球转化为§Y盖亚星球§!。
entries.en: Terraforms the planet into a §YGaia World§! on completion.

entries.zh: 通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。\n\n从今天起，§Y[Root.GetName]§!定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
entries.en: Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has come to fruition.\n\nFrom this day on, §Y[Root.GetName]§! must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

entries.zh: 我们干的不错，是时候聚焦其他事务了。
entries.en: We did well, time to focus elsewhere now.

entries.zh: 通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。\n\n从今天起，§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
entries.en: Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! has come to fruition.\n\nFrom this day on, §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy. We are sure that our vassals appreciate our efforts.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主在§Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!上完成了他们奇异的计划，将其转变成了一颗盖亚星球。承蒙照顾，我们现在可以让这座具有诗一般气候和画一般土地的天国派上用场。
entries.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on §Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!, transforming it into a Gaia world. Thanks to them we can now put the idyllic climate and vast open spaces of this paradise to good use.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主在§Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!上完成了他们奇怪的计划。这颗恒星被彻底摧毁了！他们用肮脏的平原和崎岖的高山覆盖了海洋。往日潮湿的大气也变得荒凉而干燥。更糟的是，他们对我们的困扰不屑一顾！宗主表示，他们让我们的星球“更加美丽”了。
entries.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on §Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!. The planet is ruined! They have covered the oceans with plains and rolling hills. The once humid atmosphere has grown barren and dry. Even worse, when we voiced our concerns they were rejected out of hand! The Overlords say that they have made our world "prettier."

entries.zh: 星球被成功改造成田园天堂后，一场全球范围的庆祝此事的庆典正在进行。
entries.en: A planet-wide celebration is taking place following the successful transformation of this world into an idyllic paradise.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主把我们曾经美丽的海洋星球改造成了糟糕的盖亚星球。简直吐了。
entries.en: Our Overlord has terraformed a beautiful ocean world into a nasty Gaia one. What terrible taste.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主最近将我们的一颗行星改造成了盖亚星球。他们对我们真是太好了！
entries.en: Our Overlord has recently terraformed one of our planets into a gaia world. How kind of them!

entries.en: Or any species that reproduce via vegetative propagation

entries.en: §LWith crystalline growths, this species is capable of generating self replicating lattices of themselves, in addition to the more usual reproductive methods.§!

entries.en: This species has been exposed to the transformational effects of a Gaia Seeder, causing it to sprout mutualistic blooms of lichen when living on Gaia Worlds.

entries.zh: 这个文明的工业专注于研究催化化学，并揭开了使用有机材料建造太空构造的奥秘。
entries.en: By focusing their industrial efforts on catalytic chemistry, this civilization has unlocked the key to using organic materials in the construction of spacebound structures.

entries.en: This Megacorporation seeks to maximize profits by recycling excess organic matter into advanced resources suitable for spacebound structures.

entries.en: The Hive Mind reprocesses excess organic matter into advanced resources suitable for spacebound structures.

entries.zh: 需要大量训练有素的专业人员将原生有机物转化为坚固耐久的合金，这些合金将成为各种高级建筑必需的原材料。
entries.en: Highly trained workers are needed to turn raw organic matter into durable alloys necessary for advanced construction.

entries.zh: 珍贵的矿物质由高度专业化的催化子个体加工成牢固的合金以用作海军发展和高级建筑材料。
entries.en: Valuable organic compounds are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Catalytic Drones.
